notes: Universal slot picks - a cross-class starting frame drawn from community gearing guides. Treat these as seed examples and verify each item's exact stats, source, faction availability, and current-meta status at authoring time.

shared.name: Green Tinted Goggles
shared.notes: Strong Engineering head frame for many specs (competes with Lucky Fishing Hat); takes a Lesser Arcanum head enchant like any head. Verify current stats. wowheadId confirmed via Wowhead Classic (item=4385).

shared.name: Lucky Fishing Hat
shared.notes: Alternative head; harder to obtain than the goggles. Verify current stats. wowheadId confirmed via Wowhead Classic (item=19972).

shared.name: Sentinel's Medallion
shared.notes: Common neck pick from the gearing guides; the neck slot otherwise lacks a standout at this bracket. wowheadId 20444 is the Classic Era (Requires Level 18) 10-19 bracket version confirmed via Warcraft Wiki; Alliance Warsong Gulch reputation reward (Silverwing Sentinels, from Illiyana Moonblaze in Ashenvale); converts to Scout's Medallion for Horde.

shared.name: Scout's Medallion
shared.notes: Recurring neck pick across many class builds on the BiS chart. wowheadId 20442 is the Classic Era (Requires Level 18) 10-19 bracket version confirmed via Warcraft Wiki; Horde Warsong Gulch reputation reward (Warsong Outriders, from Kelm Hargunth in The Barrens); converts to Sentinel's Medallion for Alliance.
